documented_probe: C-9feab250 (configure a jupyter server via its config file to override port, listen address, and auth settings): covered at easy by a profile-file-driven port (instead of an environment variable), a wildcard listen address, and profile fallback semantics; the verifier fully checks the capability on hidden cases. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Single deliverable: a Jupyter Server config module whose listen port is derived at load time from a JSON deployment profile with strict validation and a default fallback, wildcard ip, and token/password disabled. Hidden cases rotate the profile (alternate ports, missing key, out-of-range, malformed) and are checked both statically (config-loader content check) and live (server binds the right port on a non-loopback interface and answers a tokenless 200). Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (profile validation + fallback) and adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (multiple rotated profiles).
